name: e1_retry
question: How does request retry work in this codebase, and where is it configured? Specifically: which failures are retried (and for which HTTP methods), how many attempts happen with default settings, how the delay between attempts is computed, how configuration is resolved (defaults, file, environment, per-call), and how Retry-After is handled. Point out any bugs or places where the code and documentation disagree. Cite files/functions.
